decisions.reason: The preferred Satin Reflection finish and champagne-gold distribution affect the accent's material treatment, not its locked derivation, vector geometry, alignment, or revision policy.
Applying champagne gold to the second V's right arm does not change the second V's form, construction method, height hierarchy, or optical relationship to the alphabet.
The material preference does not alter the composition requirement. The source message's separate kerning and resume decisions are already represented by same-message Events under this candidate.
The selected finish and selective gold application leave the approved Hero V geometry and its locked master-foundation status unchanged.
The material-treatment preference does not modify the shared terminal's geometry, structural basis, conclusion, or unified application rule.
The preferred metallic finish and distribution do not change the required construction, proportions, restraint, or architectural relationship of the internal letterforms.
The Satin Reflection preference is consistent with the existing warmth, refinement, and material-finish hierarchy, but it does not replace or modify any current brand-expression attribute.
The material-treatment selection does not affect the decision to use a proprietary wordmark without a separate icon or monogram.
A preferred but not finalized material direction does not change the current production-ready artwork deliverable.
